1. Definitions

"Protocol Source" means the human-readable source code, specifications, tests,
golden vectors, build scripts, and other materials in the private MoDi Protocol
source repository that are identified as LicenseRef-MoDi-Proprietary-1.0.

"Authorized Protocol Binary" means an unmodified MoDi Protocol JAR, DLL, or
NuGet package whose exact protocol version, source Commit SHA, vector-set
SHA-256, artifact SHA-256, and legal-document SHA-256 values match an authentic
protocol-artifacts.v1.json manifest issued by Silvite.

"Authorized Application" means the MoDi Connect application identified by the
accompanying MoDi Protocol Binary Redistribution Grant 1.0 and MoDi Protocol
Binary Linking Exception 1.0.

2. Protocol Source

No license to copy, modify, publish, disclose, distribute, sublicense, or create
derivative works of the Protocol Source is granted except through a separate
written agreement signed by Silvite. Possession of the Protocol Source or an
Authorized Protocol Binary does not imply a source-code license.

3. Internal Binary Use

Silvite permits an Authorized Protocol Binary to be installed, executed, and
reproduced inside Silvite-controlled development and test environments solely
for developing and verifying the Authorized Application. External conveyance
is governed by Section 4 below.

4. External Binary Distribution

An Authorized Protocol Binary may be conveyed only when every condition of the
MoDi Protocol Binary Redistribution Grant 1.0 is satisfied and the exact
accompanying manifest records an external-distribution status expressly
approved by Silvite (recorded as EXTERNAL_DISTRIBUTION_APPROVED_BY_OWNER in
protocol-artifacts.v1.json, approved by the owner on 2026-08-15). No right to
distribute a standalone SDK, modified binary, substituted binary, or Protocol
Source is granted by this license.

Except where applicable law makes a restriction unenforceable, no recipient
may remove or alter ownership notices, misrepresent the origin or approval

the identity and integrity requirements of the accompanying manifest.
